text: I adore this app! I first started using it back in 2022 or even earlier. I have been using it every day for the last year and it is very convenient. I would also like to mention the tech support, Ian - the CEO of this app and his team were very nice and helped me if I encountered any bugs and were constantly in touch until the problem was solved. I will definitely stay with them for a long time, on the journey to a better version of myself with Routinery 💜
author: Lia Nocturna
developer_reply: Hello! This is Routinery.💛 Your review is heartwarming! Knowing you use our app daily since 2022 is the greatest compliment. We are deeply grateful for your kind words about our support team's commitment to fixing bugs. Earning your trust means the world to us. If you have any suggestions, please feel free to let us know at hello@routinery.app.

text: Excellent, they added a very necessary function, without which I did not want to use the application. Now there is more flexibility in performing the routine, which is very important. Just please correct the estimated duration of the routine and its end time, when the done tasks have already been ticked (new function), so that it is clear at what time the remaining tasks will be completed.
author: Valeriia Staniievska
developer_reply: Valeria, thank you for your feedback! We're glad you find the new function useful and that it makes your routine more flexible. 😊 We appreciate your suggestion regarding the estimated duration and end time updates. If you have any more ideas or need assistance, feel free to reach out at hello@routinery.app.
